description: Nebius H100 replica of exp001 (the untied-vanilla exp709 anchor). IDENTICAL config and IDENTICAL data (base_data_climbmix 5-shard subset + tokenizer copied byte-for-byte from gpustar), same seed=1 - a cross-machine reproducibility check of the 1.2014 bpb on-box anchor and the first exercise of the multi-machine experiment workflow. Run on Nebius H100 (sm_90). hyperplane_ffn baseline: on-gpustar replica of the LUTGPT-report untied vanilla anchor exp709 (MinimalGPT + RoPE, untied head, 35.79M params). Config is exp709 verbatim (depth6/n_embd384/n_head6/seq512, device_bs48, total_bs24576 grad_accum=1, 16K steps = 393M tokens, lr3e-4, wd0.1, warmup0.1, seed1, bf16, vocab32768). Original exp709 reached 1.1922 bpb on the Nebius full ClimbMix; this run uses the local base_data_climbmix subset, so the achieved bpb is the on-box anchor for all hyperplane_ffn experiments (expected close to 1.1922, may differ due to the data subset). All hyperplane_ffn ideas compare against THIS number.
